strings.zh: 我的伊布{NEWLINE}进化成为太阳精灵了哟~{SCROLL}可是,朋友的伊布{NEWLINE}却进化成为月亮精灵了。{SCROLL}到底有什么地方不一样呢？{NEWLINE}我们两人明明都是{CLEAR}照着伊布习性培养的。
strings.en: My Eevee evolved into an Espeon.{NEWLINE}But my friend’s Eevee turned into{CLEAR}an Umbreon. What made the difference?{SCROLL}We both definitely raised our Eevee{NEWLINE}to suit its nature...
strings.notes: US 0613/0; modernised from US 0613#0 | RV040: meaning: 照着伊布习性培养 = raised according to Eevee's nature, not 'in the same way'

strings.zh: 给其使用元气碎片的话,{NEWLINE}濒死的精灵也会变得很精神哦。
strings.en: If you use Revive, a Pokémon that has{NEWLINE}fainted will wake right up.

strings.zh: 铃铛塔现在还没有开放参观,{NEWLINE}只能先来这儿买点小纪念品了。
strings.en: The Bell Tower isn’t open to visitors{NEWLINE}right now, so I came here to buy some{CLEAR}little souvenirs instead.
